title: Fire Bolt
summary: Hurls a bolt of ash-fire at a foe (reach 7), dealing 16-24 fire damage. Cost: 8 mana, CD: 30.

p: Hurls a bolt of ash-fire at a foe (reach 7), dealing 16-24 fire damage. Cost: 8 mana, CD: 30.
A pinched coal-spark loosed down a copper-bound ley-line.
Take the cinder to heart.

title: Fireball
summary: Launches an explosive sphere at the ground (reach 8, radius 2), dealing 18-28 fire damage. Cost: 14, CD: 40.

p: Launches an explosive sphere at the ground (reach 8, radius 2), dealing 18-28 fire damage. Cost: 14, CD: 40.
Pressurized tallow-gas and sulfur igniting in a tight red bloom.
Clear the dry brush!

title: Flame Burst
summary: Splits into up to 3 fiery shards within radius 3.5 (reach 7), dealing 12-18 fire damage each. Cost: 12, CD: 35.

p: Splits into up to 3 fiery shards within radius 3.5 (reach 7), dealing 12-18 fire damage each. Cost: 12, CD: 35.
Three splintered embers seeking dry wool, oiled leather, and flesh.
Scatter the coals!

title: Ignite
summary: Sets a foe ablaze (reach 6), inflicting burn (2) for 6s. Cost: 8 mana, CD: 30.

p: Sets a foe ablaze (reach 6), inflicting burn (2) for 6s. Cost: 8 mana, CD: 30.
Slow pitch-flame that clings to wet cloth and chars bone beneath.
Smolder from the marrow out.

title: Frost Bolt
summary: Strikes a foe with river-ice (reach 7) for 12-18 water damage and slows for 8s. Cost: 8, CD: 30.

p: Strikes a foe with river-ice (reach 7) for 12-18 water damage and slows for 8s. Cost: 8, CD: 30.
A needle of cistern-ice drawn from winter's deep pressure.
Stiffen in the mire.

title: Ice Storm
summary: Pelts an area with sleet (reach 8, radius 2.5) for 10-16 damage, slowing foes for 6s. Cost: 16, CD: 45.

p: Pelts an area with sleet (reach 8, radius 2.5) for 10-16 damage, slowing foes for 6s. Cost: 16, CD: 45.
Sleet and jagged hail sheared from the upper mountain winds.
Bury the road in rime.

title: Chain Frost
summary: Bounces across 4 foes in radius 3.5 (reach 7) for 9-14 damage, slowing for 4s. Cost: 14, CD: 40.

p: Bounces across 4 foes in radius 3.5 (reach 7) for 9-14 damage, slowing for 4s. Cost: 14, CD: 40.
Cold leaps from damp cloak to damp cloak like river-freeze.
Share the winter among you.

title: Healing
summary: Mends an ally's wounds (reach 7), restoring 30-45 HP. Cost: 10 mana, CD: 30.

p: Mends an ally's wounds (reach 7), restoring 30-45 HP. Cost: 10 mana, CD: 30.
Warmth coaxed back into torn sinew with a steady pulse of mana.
Get up; your pay isn't spent.

title: Healing Rain
summary: Showers a 3-radius area (reach 8), restoring 14-22 HP to allies within. Cost: 18 mana, CD: 50.

p: Showers a 3-radius area (reach 8), restoring 14-22 HP to allies within. Cost: 18 mana, CD: 50.
Clean mountain mist that washes grime and fever from the line.
Drink before the mud takes it.

title: Lightning
summary: Strikes a foe with a high-voltage arc (reach 8) for 24-34 air damage. Cost: 12 mana, CD: 35.

p: Strikes a foe with a high-voltage arc (reach 8) for 24-34 air damage. Cost: 12 mana, CD: 35.
A grounded arc of telluric current snapping to iron helms.
Stand tall in the open.

title: Chain Lightning
summary: Arcs across 4 targets within radius 3.5 (reach 7), dealing 14-22 air damage. Cost: 16, CD: 40.

p: Arcs across 4 targets within radius 3.5 (reach 7), dealing 14-22 air damage. Cost: 16, CD: 40.
High-voltage discharge hopping across wet mail and raised pikes.
From buckle to blade!

title: Haste
summary: Quickens an ally's stride and swing (reach 7) with haste for 25s. Cost: 12 mana, CD: 30.

p: Quickens an ally's stride and swing (reach 7) with haste for 25s. Cost: 12 mana, CD: 30.
Tightens the breath and quickens tired legs before the breach.
Double-time, or die in the mud!

title: Gale
summary: Buffets a 3-radius area (reach 8) for 8-12 air damage and slows foes for 5s. Cost: 12, CD: 40.

p: Buffets a 3-radius area (reach 8) for 8-12 air damage and slows foes for 5s. Cost: 12, CD: 40.
A bitter marsh squall that fouls bowstrings and staggers shields.
Against the teeth of the wind!

title: Wind Ward
summary: Sheathes the caster in whirling air, granting a 35-point shield for 45s. Cost: 8 mana, CD: 30.

p: Sheathes the caster in whirling air, granting a 35-point shield for 45s. Cost: 8 mana, CD: 30.
A humming pressure-shell that turns aside slung stone and bolt.
Turn the shaft aside.

title: Rock Throw
summary: Hurls a jagged chunk of granite at a foe (reach 7) for 18-26 earth damage. Cost: 9, CD: 32.

p: Hurls a jagged chunk of granite at a foe (reach 7) for 18-26 earth damage. Cost: 9, CD: 32.
Basalt wrenched from the earth and hurled with siege-arm force.
Stone is cheaper than steel.

title: Stone Curse
summary: Calcifies a foe (reach 6), petrifying them into stone for 5s. Cost: 16 mana, CD: 40.

p: Calcifies a foe (reach 6), petrifying them into stone for 5s. Cost: 16 mana, CD: 40.
Calcifies joint and marrow until a soldier stands as limestone.
Be still and wait for the chisel.

title: Stone Skin
summary: Hardens an ally's flesh (reach 7) with a 50-point earth shield for 45s. Cost: 10, CD: 30.

p: Hardens an ally's flesh (reach 7) with a 50-point earth shield for 45s. Cost: 10, CD: 30.
Hardens bruised hide with a crust of compressed quarry-slate.
Wear the mountain's hide.

title: Poison Cloud
summary: Fills a 2.5-radius area (reach 8) with toxic marsh gas, poisoning (1) for 12s. Cost: 12, CD: 40.

p: Fills a 2.5-radius area (reach 8) with toxic marsh gas, poisoning (1) for 12s. Cost: 12, CD: 40.
Stagnant peat-fume and copperas drifting low over the mud.
Breathe deep of the fen.

title: Quake
summary: Ruptures the ground (reach 7, radius 3.5), dealing 20-30 earth damage. Cost: 22 mana, CD: 60.

p: Ruptures the ground (reach 7, radius 3.5), dealing 20-30 earth damage. Cost: 22 mana, CD: 60.
Strikes the bedrock seam until palisades and kneecaps buckle.
Let the cellar swallow the hall!

title: Blessing
summary: Steadies an ally's hand and spirit (reach 7), granting bless for 60s. Cost: 10 mana, CD: 30.

p: Steadies an ally's hand and spirit (reach 7), granting bless for 60s. Cost: 10 mana, CD: 30.
Steadies the sword-hand with a cold oath of the First Watch.
Steady the hand, narrow the eye.

title: Weaken
summary: Saps a foe's sinews (reach 7), inflicting weaken for 30s. Cost: 8 mana, CD: 30.

p: Saps a foe's sinews (reach 7), inflicting weaken for 30s. Cost: 8 mana, CD: 30.
Bleeds iron-will from the limbs like a cracked tallow lamp.
Your bones remember their age.

title: Resurrect
summary: Calls a fallen combatant back from a corpse (reach 6). Cost: 30 mana, CD: 75.

p: Calls a fallen combatant back from a corpse (reach 6). Cost: 30 mana, CD: 75.
Reclaims a fresh corpse under Third-Dynasty probate bone-law.
Your shift is not finished.

title: Corpse Burst
summary: Detonates a corpse (reach 7, radius 2.5), dealing 18-26 astral damage. Cost: 14, CD: 50.

p: Detonates a corpse (reach 7, radius 2.5), dealing 18-26 astral damage. Cost: 14, CD: 50.
Ruptures trapped gas in a fallen carcass, scything nearby foes.
Serve one last time.

title: Meditation
summary: Centers the mind to restore 12 mana to the caster. Cost: 0 mana, CD: 250.

p: Centers the mind to restore 12 mana to the caster. Cost: 0 mana, CD: 250.
Slows the pulse to draw stray current from the damp earth.
Silence behind the eyes.

title: Meteor
summary: Calls down a molten crag (reach 8, radius 3) for 32-48 damage and burn (4) for 8s. Cost: 26, CD: 70.

p: Calls down a molten crag (reach 8, radius 3) for 32-48 damage and burn (4) for 8s. Cost: 26, CD: 70.
Calls down white-hot caldera slag to crush shield-walls flat.
The sky settles the ledger!

title: Inferno
summary: Engulfs up to 5 foes in radius 4 (reach 7) for 22-34 fire damage each. Cost: 20 mana, CD: 45.

p: Engulfs up to 5 foes in radius 4 (reach 7) for 22-34 fire damage each. Cost: 20 mana, CD: 45.
Unleashes pent-up furnace draft across five choked targets.
Roast in your own mail!

title: Blizzard
summary: Unleashes a freezing gale (reach 8, radius 3.5) for 20-30 damage, slowing for 10s. Cost: 24, CD: 65.

p: Unleashes a freezing gale (reach 8, radius 3.5) for 20-30 damage, slowing for 10s. Cost: 24, CD: 65.
Buries a whole crossing in blinding sleet and frostbite.
Winter comes early this year.

title: Thunderstorm
summary: Strikes 4 foes in radius 4 (reach 8) with 26-38 air damage each. Cost: 22 mana, CD: 50.

p: Strikes 4 foes in radius 4 (reach 8) with 26-38 air damage each. Cost: 22 mana, CD: 50.
Four merciless sky-bolts hunting every copper buckle in range.
Count the seconds to the thunder!

title: Iron Skin
summary: Encases the caster in living plate, granting a 100-point shield for 60s. Cost: 18 mana, CD: 60.

p: Encases the caster in living plate, granting a 100-point shield for 60s. Cost: 18 mana, CD: 60.
Plates the body in tempered slag-sheen that turns keen steel.
Break your teeth upon me.

title: Acid Rain
summary: Corrosive downpour (reach 8, radius 3.5) dealing 14-20 damage and poison (2) for 16s. Cost: 20, CD: 55.

p: Corrosive downpour (reach 8, radius 3.5) dealing 14-20 damage and poison (2) for 16s. Cost: 20, CD: 55.
Vitriol-laced drizzle that pits iron plate and blisters skin.
Rust in the standing rain.

title: Mana Burn
summary: Ignites a foe's internal aether (reach 7), dealing 25-40 astral damage. Cost: 15 mana, CD: 40.

p: Ignites a foe's internal aether (reach 7), dealing 25-40 astral damage. Cost: 15 mana, CD: 40.
Shorts an enemy caster's ward-coil, scorching mind and marrow.
Choke on your own craft.

title: Time Warp
summary: Bends the local hour around the caster, granting haste for 40s. Cost: 25 mana, CD: 80.

p: Bends the local hour around the caster, granting haste for 40s. Cost: 25 mana, CD: 80.
Overclocks the blood-beat until arrows seem to crawl in air.
Step between the seconds.

title: Shield Bash
summary: Slams your shield into an adjacent foe (reach 1), dealing 14-20 physical damage and stunning for 2s. Cost: 10 mana, CD: 25.

p: Slams your shield into an adjacent foe (reach 1), dealing 14-20 physical damage and stunning for 2s. Cost: 10 mana, CD: 25.
Drives an iron rim into jaw and ribs to break the guard.
Eat iron!

title: Cleave Arc
summary: Sweeps your weapon in a wide front arc (reach 2), hitting up to 3 foes for 18-26 physical damage. Cost: 14 mana, CD: 30.

p: Sweeps your weapon in a wide front arc (reach 2), hitting up to 3 foes for 18-26 physical damage. Cost: 14 mana, CD: 30.
A wide two-handed sweep meant to clear three pikemen at once.
Clear the line!

title: Hamstring Cut
summary: Slices low across a target's leg (reach 1), dealing 12-18 damage and slowing movement by 45% for 5s. Cost: 9 mana, CD: 28.

p: Slices low across a target's leg (reach 1), dealing 12-18 damage and slowing movement by 45% for 5s. Cost: 9 mana, CD: 28.
Low blade-work aimed behind the greave to lame a fleeing foe.
Stay put!

title: Sunder Plate
summary: Crushes enemy armor with a downward blow (reach 1), dealing 20-28 damage and reducing Armor by 12 for 6s. Cost: 15 mana, CD: 35.

p: Crushes enemy armor with a downward blow (reach 1), dealing 20-28 damage and reducing Armor by 12 for 6s. Cost: 15 mana, CD: 35.
Heavy overhead impact that splits rivets and dents breastplates.
Crack their shell!

title: Grit Through Pain
summary: Shrugs off fresh wounds, restoring 28-36 HP and cleansing bleed effects immediately. Cost: 14 mana, CD: 50.

p: Shrugs off fresh wounds, restoring 28-36 HP and cleansing bleed effects immediately. Cost: 14 mana, CD: 50.
Bites down on leather, binds the rag, and keeps standing.
Not done yet!

title: Whirlwind Maul
summary: Spins violently (radius 2), striking all surrounding enemies twice for 15-22 damage per hit. Cost: 22 mana, CD: 55.

p: Spins violently (radius 2), striking all surrounding enemies twice for 15-22 damage per hit. Cost: 22 mana, CD: 55.
A spinning iron storm that punishes any pack closing in.
Step back or bleed!

title: Executioner's Blow
summary: Delivers a massive overhead strike (reach 1) for 34-46 physical damage, dealing +50% to foes below 30% HP. Cost: 24 mana, CD: 60.

p: Delivers a massive overhead strike (reach 1) for 34-46 physical damage, dealing +50% to foes below 30% HP. Cost: 24 mana, CD: 60.
No appeals, no ledgers—just a clean parting of head and shoulders.
End of the road!

title: Bodkin Shot
summary: Fires a heavy armor-piercing arrow (reach 9), dealing 18-25 physical damage and ignoring 10 Armor. Cost: 10 mana, CD: 25.

p: Fires a heavy armor-piercing arrow (reach 9), dealing 18-25 physical damage and ignoring 10 Armor. Cost: 10 mana, CD: 25.
Narrow square-headed iron punched straight through chain links.
Through the plate!

title: Volley of Reeds
summary: Rains arrows onto a target area (reach 9, radius 2), dealing 14-20 physical damage to all foes within. Cost: 16 mana, CD: 38.

p: Rains arrows onto a target area (reach 9, radius 2), dealing 14-20 physical damage to all foes within. Cost: 16 mana, CD: 38.
A whistling sheaf of shafts dropped behind raised pavises.
Loose the sky!

title: Heartseeker
summary: Takes careful aim at a single distant target (reach 10), dealing 36-48 damage with +30% Crit Chance. Cost: 24 mana, CD: 58.

p: Takes careful aim at a single distant target (reach 10), dealing 36-48 damage with +30% Crit Chance. Cost: 24 mana, CD: 58.
One held breath, one true release, aimed for the gorget gap.
Lights out.

title: Cinder Lance
summary: Fires a compressed beam of white-hot ash (reach 8), dealing 20-28 fire damage and igniting for 6/s. Cost: 14 mana, CD: 30.

p: Fires a compressed beam of white-hot ash (reach 8), dealing 20-28 fire damage and igniting for 6/s. Cost: 14 mana, CD: 30.
A narrow jet of furnace-flame that pierces shield and surcoat.
Burn clean!

title: Brine Frost
summary: Freezes coastal spray over a target area (reach 7, radius 2), dealing 16-22 cold damage and slowing 40% for 4s. Cost: 15 mana, CD: 34.

p: Freezes coastal spray over a target area (reach 7, radius 2), dealing 16-22 cold damage and slowing 40% for 4s. Cost: 15 mana, CD: 34.
Salt-chilled slush that locks boots fast to the cobbles.
Freeze solid!

title: Static Arc
summary: Discharges jagged copper sparks (reach 6), dealing 18-26 lightning damage; deals +30% in water or mud. Cost: 12 mana, CD: 28.

p: Discharges jagged copper sparks (reach 6), dealing 18-26 lightning damage; deals +30% in water or mud. Cost: 12 mana, CD: 28.
A short blue snap from knuckles primed with crushed quartz.
Ground yourself!

title: Peat-Gas Blast
summary: Ignites subterranean swamp fumes (reach 7, radius 2), dealing 22-30 fire damage and knocking foes back. Cost: 19 mana, CD: 42.

p: Ignites subterranean swamp fumes (reach 7, radius 2), dealing 22-30 fire damage and knocking foes back. Cost: 19 mana, CD: 42.
Ignites pocketed bog-vapor in a sudden, concussive thump.
Up in smoke!

title: Siphon Ley
summary: Draws ambient magic from a target (reach 7), dealing 14-20 arcane damage and restoring 20 Mana. Cost: 6 mana, CD: 32.

p: Draws ambient magic from a target (reach 7), dealing 14-20 arcane damage and restoring 20 Mana. Cost: 6 mana, CD: 32.
Taps an enemy's stray charge to feed your own dry wards.
Mine now.

title: Vitrify
summary: Superheats the ground under an enemy (reach 8), dealing 38-50 fire damage and turning sand or ash to glass. Cost: 28 mana, CD: 62.

p: Superheats the ground under an enemy (reach 8), dealing 38-50 fire damage and turning sand or ash to glass. Cost: 28 mana, CD: 62.
Melts sand, iron, and flesh into dark translucent slag.
Turn to glass!

title: Marrow Dart
summary: Fires a splintered bone shard (reach 8), dealing 15-22 physical/shadow damage and healing you for 8 HP. Cost: 10 mana, CD: 24.

p: Fires a splintered bone shard (reach 8), dealing 15-22 physical/shadow damage and healing you for 8 HP. Cost: 10 mana, CD: 24.
A sharpened femur-splinter loosed with cold probate precision.
Take a splinter!

title: Grave Chill
summary: Releases tomb-cold mist around you (radius 3), dealing 14-20 cold damage and slowing attack speed 25% for 5s. Cost: 14 mana, CD: 35.

p: Releases tomb-cold mist around you (radius 3), dealing 14-20 cold damage and slowing attack speed 25% for 5s. Cost: 14 mana, CD: 35.
Exhales cellar-cold air from an unsealed ossuary vault.
Feel the grave.

title: Pinning Bodkin
summary: Drives a heavy bodkin through boot and turf, rooting target for 3s.

p: Drives a heavy bodkin through boot and turf, rooting target for 3s.
A good shaft saves three mercenaries from running uphill.

title: Visor Split
summary: Threads an arrow through armor seams, ignoring 50% physical armor.

p: Threads an arrow through armor seams, ignoring 50% physical armor.
Plate only works when the wearer keeps his chin down.

title: Serrated Broadhead
summary: Barbed point inflicts 5 bleed damage per second for 5s.

p: Barbed point inflicts 5 bleed damage per second for 5s.
Pulling it out hurts twice as much as taking it in.

title: Crippling Tendon
summary: Severs heel-sinew, slowing target movement and attack speed by 40%.

p: Severs heel-sinew, slowing target movement and attack speed by 40%.
Nobody charges a shield-wall on one working ankle.

title: Raking Volley
summary: Looses a spread of ash-shafts across a 3-tile area.

p: Looses a spread of ash-shafts across a 3-tile area.
Measure the wind once, then darken the whole ditch.

title: Suppressive Arc
summary: Pins a 3.5-tile zone for 4s, halting enemy casts and slowing advance.

p: Pins a 3.5-tile zone for 4s, halting enemy casts and slowing advance.
Keep their heads below the parapet while the pikes close.

title: Hail of Yew
summary: Rains steel-tipped shafts across 4 tiles, piercing armor and morale.

p: Rains steel-tipped shafts across 4 tiles, piercing armor and morale.
Thornwick bowyers count their wages by the wagonload.

title: Briar Snare
summary: Plants hidden iron-thorns that root and bleed the first foe to step.

p: Plants hidden iron-thorns that root and bleed the first foe to step.
Fen poachers never chase prey when wire does the holding.

title: Marsh-Adder Venom
summary: Coats quiver in bog-bile; arrows deal +6 poison/s for 8s.

p: Coats quiver in bog-bile; arrows deal +6 poison/s for 8s.
Milked from vipers drowned in Redmarsh brine.

title: Reed-Smoke Screen
summary: Chokes a 3-tile patch in peat-smoke, granting allies +35% evasion.

p: Chokes a 3-tile patch in peat-smoke, granting allies +35% evasion.
Even crossbows miss what they cannot smell through wet peat.

title: Carrion Mark
summary: Tags a target for focus fire; all squad hits gain +20% crit chance.

p: Tags a target for focus fire; all squad hits gain +20% crit chance.
Crows always circle the one limping behind the line.

title: Gale Step
summary: Breaks roots and grants +50% movement speed for 4s.

p: Breaks roots and grants +50% movement speed for 4s.
Never stand where a heavy infantryman has room to swing.

title: Spore-Pod Shot
summary: Bursts a toxic puff-sac on impact, poisoning enemies within 2.5 tiles.

p: Bursts a toxic puff-sac on impact, poisoning enemies within 2.5 tiles.
Harvested with tongs from Redmarsh's rotting willows.

title: Falcon's Bearing
summary: Sharpens sightlines, granting +2 reach and +25% accuracy for 8s.

p: Sharpens sightlines, granting +2 reach and +25% accuracy for 8s.
Read the surf and the crosswind, and every target stands still.

title: Thornwood Ambush
summary: Erupts tangled strangler-roots across 3.5 tiles, rooting and bleeding.

p: Erupts tangled strangler-roots across 3.5 tiles, rooting and bleeding.
Greywood remembers every axe ever laid against its bark.

title: Splinter Writ
summary: Fires a calcified rib-shard that pierces flesh and chips 2 armor.

p: Fires a calcified rib-shard that pierces flesh and chips 2 armor.
Every pauper's grave holds plenty of affordable ammunition.

title: Raise Indentured
summary: Calls a fallen debtor's skeleton to fight for 25s until its tally clears.

p: Calls a fallen debtor's skeleton to fight for 25s until its tally clears.
Dying mid-shift does not excuse anyone from finishing the watch.

title: Ribcage Bulwark
summary: Plates an ally in borrowed femurs, absorbing 45 physical damage for 8s.

p: Plates an ally in borrowed femurs, absorbing 45 physical damage for 8s.
Second-hand bone stops steel just as well as fresh iron.

title: Marrow Shrapnel
summary: Shatters a bone construct or corpse, dealing piercing AoE in 2.5 tiles.

p: Shatters a bone construct or corpse, dealing piercing AoE in 2.5 tiles.
Liquidated assets rarely leave clean flagstones behind.

title: Ossuary Cage
summary: Locks target inside interlocking ribs for 3.5s, halting movement.

p: Locks target inside interlocking ribs for 3.5s, halting movement.
Consider it temporary detention pending probate review.

title: Phalanx of Arrears
summary: Summons three armored bone-bailiffs to hold a choke point for 20s.

p: Summons three armored bone-bailiffs to hold a choke point for 20s.
Defaulted oaths make the most disciplined infantry in Thornvael.

title: Exact Tithe
summary: Draws 14–20 astral damage and transfers 50% as health to the caster.

p: Draws 14–20 astral damage and transfers 50% as health to the caster.
A modest installment collected directly from the debtor's pulse.

title: Compound Interest
summary: Curses foe for 8s; each hit taken adds +3 astral damage to the next.

p: Curses foe for 8s; each hit taken adds +3 astral damage to the next.
Unpaid balances grow heavier with every heartbeat.

title: Garnish Vigor
summary: Siphons target's stamina, slowing swings 30% and restoring 12 party mana.

p: Siphons target's stamina, slowing swings 30% and restoring 12 party mana.
If they cannot pay in coin, they can pay in breath.

title: Lien of Blood
summary: Grants an ally +25% lifesteal for 8s as enemies settle their tab.

p: Grants an ally +25% lifesteal for 8s as enemies settle their tab.
Countersigned in red ink and enforced at sword-point.

title: Foreclosure
summary: Executes targets below 25% HP for double astral damage, healing allies.

p: Executes targets below 25% HP for double astral damage, healing allies.
When the seal is stamped, the account closes permanently.

title: Cold Ledger
summary: Chills a 2.5-tile patch with grave-rime, slowing foes by 35% for 5s.

p: Chills a 2.5-tile patch with grave-rime, slowing foes by 35% for 5s.
Nothing preserves an unsettled contract like frost.

title: Witness the Fallen
summary: Consumes a nearby corpse to restore 22 mana and 25 HP to the caster.

p: Consumes a nearby corpse to restore 22 mana and 25 HP to the caster.
Properly recorded, even a stranger's death balances the books.

title: Grave-Quiet
summary: Smothers target in tomb-silence for 4s, halting all spellcasting.

p: Smothers target in tomb-silence for 4s, halting all spellcasting.
Speak only when summoned; the court is in recess.

title: Toll of the Pale
summary: Rings a funeral chime in 3.5 tiles, dealing cold/astral damage and fear.

p: Rings a funeral chime in 3.5 tiles, dealing cold/astral damage and fear.
Every soldier knows the sound of his own muster-roll closing.

title: Forgive the Oath
summary: Releases bound spirits to heal allies in 3 tiles and purge all hexes.

p: Releases bound spirits to heal allies in 3 tiles and purge all hexes.
The rarest entry in any mortuary book: paid in full.
